en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tram passing in front of a historic castle-like building with towers and steep roofs, surrounded by bare trees and fencing. Pedestrians walk along the street and a small cart stands on the right. The bottom of the card has printed red text identifying the location, and small publisher information is printed in red at the lower left.
